title: Tensor product of finite free dual modules
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M,N$ finite free $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module], meaning each has a basis with finitely many indices (the empty basis is allowed). Write $M^*=\operatorname{Hom}_R(M,R)$ and $N^*=\operatorname{Hom}_R(N,R)$ for linear duals, and use tensor products [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. The canonical linear map $M^*\otimes_RN^*\to\operatorname{Hom}_R(M\otimes_RN,R)$ sending $f\otimes g$ to the functional $m\otimes n\mapsto f(m)g(n)$ is an isomorphism.
